rule: Existence -> production/delivery -> unit conversion -> frontline readiness -> local allocation are separate clocks. Historical introduction dates are fallback only where no branch entry exists. A production start before the cutoff does not by itself establish a frontline unit; post-cutoff events must use a dated fielding gate where one exists.

D4Y.bomber: late-1942 deployment clock, but June 1943 branch only guarantees limited bomber-trial/operational elements; event counts required

E16A_Zuiun.restart_rule: Initial deliveries exist, but 1943-10-01 does not imply a combat-ready local detachment. First combat-capable detachments center Oct-Nov.

late_zero.zuisei_late: Primary operational carrier fighter at the 1943-10-01 cutoff; use event-specific readiness and carrier allocation.
late_zero.kinsei_zero_cutoff_state: PRE_FRONTLINE / CARRIER-TRIAL-TO-INITIAL-PRODUCTION TRANSITION. Authoritative HARD source has first pilot-production in 1943-09, but no combat-ready frontline carrier unit is assumed at the 1943-10-01 cutoff.
late_zero.post_cutoff_rule: For events after 1943-10-01, do not keep Kinsei Zero at zero by inertia. Resolve production -> acceptance -> carrier trials -> unit conversion -> local allocation through GALVANIC_KINSEI_ZERO_FIELDING_GATE_1943-11_v002 when applicable.

late_aug_sep.rule: new Essex/Independence force is additive to branch losses, not restoration of old named carriers

united_states.october: Exact carrier/air-group count, readiness and raid axis require event adjudication.

anti_backport: Kinsei Zero is not a frontline operational type at the 1943-10-01 cutoff; its Sep-1943 pilot production is real but must pass a post-cutoff fielding/allocation gate before combat use.
A7M is not frontline operational by cutoff and cannot be back-ported.
Zuiun not mass operational at restart
